data.narrative:
Peak Quantum is a pre-seed stage quantum computing company founded by Leon Koch (CEO) and co-led by Alexander Schult, Thomas Luschmann, Max Werninghaus, and others. The target has raised €5M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public peers (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 6 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Stage-progression valuation is the applicable method here, using the €5M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from pre-seed to next stage, yielding €12M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 6 same-sector private peers exist, none satisfy narrow filter criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier combinations); a broader all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and is therefore excluded from the triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €11M (low) to €14M (high), with a median of €12M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty given the limited comparable data at the pre-seed stage in quantum computing. Key risks to valuation include technology maturity validation, competitive positioning relative to better-capitalized peers, and execution risk inherent to early-stage hardware ventures. Additional data on seed-stage comparable transactions or revenue traction would narrow this range materially.
